Senior Backend Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable systems in Node.js or Go. You will own our payments infrastructure and mentor junior engineers.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of backend engineering experience, ideally with Node.js or Go
- Experience designing and operating distributed systems at scale
- Strong communication skills; comfortable mentoring junior engineers
- Bonus points for experience with Kubernetes

We offer competitive pay, remote work, and a collaborative engineering culture.
